name: Do I need a permit for kitchen window replacement in cities like Pacifica or Daly City?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for kitchen window replacement in cities like Pacifica or Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether a permit is required for kitchen window replacement can depend on local building codes in specific Bay Area cities like Pacifica or Daly City. Minor replacements where windows fit existing openings without structural changes often do not require a permit. However, if the project involves altering the size or location of the window opening, structural modifications, or changes to egress, a permit is usually necessary. It is always best to consult with your general contractor, who can advise on local regulations and obtain any required permits.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits may be needed if replacing kitchen windows involves structural changes or altering opening sizes; your contractor can advise on local requirements.
